title: Intern Data Analysis (m/w/d)
description:
About The Job

As a Data Analysis Intern based in Munich, you will work closely with our stores across Germany and Austria, providing first-line support on a daily basis. You will assist in coordinating Retail Performance initiatives and contribute to enhancing the client experience in our stores. Acting as a key liaison between our Retail teams and various Head Office functions—including Retail Performance and Learning—you will play an integral role in driving operational excellence.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

12 months

Start: 01.04.2026

Job responsibilities

On a monthly basis, your main tasks will include:


 * KPI Monitoring & Analysis: Proactively review, monitor, and conduct weekly and monthly operational and turnover KPI reporting.
 * Data Analysis: Perform in-depth data analyses across various retail KPIs, with a strong focus on client experience, to support store teams in fostering customer satisfaction.
 * Reporting & Coaching Initiatives: Develop new reporting approaches for in-store coaching programs in close collaboration with the Learning team, ensuring continuous and qualitative follow-ups for store teams.
 * Retail Communication: Actively promote internal tools and processes for stores through the weekly internal Retail Magazine, working cross-functionally to ensure engaging content.
 * Training & Workshops: Support the organization of workshops and training sessions aimed at optimizing store operations and processes.
 * Project Support: Assist the Retail Performance team with ad hoc projects to enhance the client experience and support daily business operations.
   
   

Profile


 * Fluency in English and German is required; French is an asset.
 * Available for a 12-month internship, starting April 1st, 2026.
 * Advanced data analysis and reporting skills, with proven experience in analyzing and visualizing large data sets.
 * Advanced in MS Office, particularly Word and PowerPoint. Additionally, exceptional Excel skills with the ability to conduct independent analyses and create reports.
 * Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build professional relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
 * Previous experience in a client-centric service environment is essential.
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 * Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, work independently, and meet tight deadlines.
 * A proactive team player who thrives in a dynamic, multicultural environment.
 * An agile, entrepreneurial mindset, with a problem-solving approach to challenges.
   
   

Additional information

We offer you an interesting and challenging role in an international and dynamic environment. If you see yourself in this description, we look forward to receiving your online application.

Reference LVM31855
sector: Retail Apparel and Fashion, Retail Luxury Goods and Jewelry, and Retail

title: Compliance Associate
description:
A successful boutique global consulting firm focused on risk, finance and strategy is looking for a Risk & Compliance Associate to join their German office on a remote basis with some events with the German team throughout the year.




This is a great role with huge scope for progression working with a collaborate and innovative team of people supporting two partners and:




Responsibilities will include:




 * Responsible for executing selected aspects/tasks relating to internal projects, with a strong emphasis on Legal, Risk & Compliance, etc.
 * Coordination of tasks with various stakeholders within the global firm, covering both client facing and internal support team members, across several functions
 * Close collaboration with local (in-country) operations managers on range of Legal, Risk and Compliance initiatives and internal projects
 * Performing gap analyses, drafting remediation / implementation plans for a range of Legal, Risk and Compliance matters across the global firm
 * Review and (re)design, as well as implementation / embedment of sustainable operational processes or procedures, and supporting stakeholders through adopting changes
 * Fact-finding and assessment of status quo, as well as data analysis using data extracts from various environments and presenting information to Senior Management
 * Development of templates and ad-hoc reports/dashboards using, amongst other tools/applications, the Microsoft Office Suite (incl. Excel, Forms, PowerPoint, Teams) and various internal reporting capabilities
 * Developing/Documenting relevant policies and procedures and train other personnel where required
 * Supporting the organisation with the collection and capture of new data, as well as general improvement of existing data quality across relevant systems and processes
 * Follow-up and resolution of bottlenecks across various operational and administrative processes
 * Identify shortcomings, gaps or needs in existing processes, procedures and data, propose solutions for remediation and implement tactical solutions where required
 * Project management and progress tracking/reporting on various initiatives across the internal project landscape




Understanding of and experience required with:




 * Experience with professional services companies
 * Compliance monitoring and assessment
 * Contract management and execution
 * Insurance portfolio management
 * The development of governance, compliance and/or risk management frameworks
 * Working with variety of legal and compliance experts across different aspects of law and regulation
 * Concepts such as risk management frameworks, processes, polices and procedures




Additional skills required:




 * Strong coordination/organisation and effective communication skills, with an ability to drive towards outcomes and convergence across different stakeholders
 * Excellent verbal and formal writing skills in both German and English
 * Ability to prioritise and take initiative
 * Someone with proactiveness, perseverance, a sense of ownership, clear and effective communication
 * Fluent German speaker and proficient in English




Salary up to 75,000 Euros plus benefits (negotiable for the right candidate).




This is a remote role.

title: Support Analyst
description:
About Us

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world.

Your Mission

As Support Analyst, you will serve as the frontline technical and functional expert for customers using the Hawk platform, ensuring a seamless user experience. You will provide expert guidance on rule configuration, user management, workflows, and integration troubleshooting via our ticketing system while collaborating with internal teams to resolve complex issues. We are seeking a proactive problem solver, who can communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders fluently in German and English and ensure high customer satisfaction.

Your Responsibilities


 * Provide timely, high-quality support for customers via our ticketing system, assisting with rule configuration, user management, workflow optimization, and integrations.
 * Troubleshoot rule behaviour and configuration issues and investigate why alerts trigger (or don’t) and identifying root causes across data, configuration, and platform behaviour.
 * Diagnose, prioritize, and resolve system errors, collaborating with engineers and product teams to identify root causes and implement fixes.
 * Notify customers of incidents, document root cause analyses in collaboration with engineers, and ensure clear communication throughout the resolution process.
 * Work closely with internal teams to resolve complex issues, escalate critical cases, and relay customer feedback for product improvements.
 * Participate professionally in international video conference calls, providing clear, concise explanations of technical issues and solutions to a diverse customer base.
 * Develop comprehensive documentation for both technical and non-technical users, ensuring clarity in troubleshooting steps, platform functionality, and best practices.
 * Apply your understanding of Fraud Prevention, Compliance, and/or Payments Processing to guide customers effectively in a highly regulated and complex environment.
   
   

Your Profile


 * 3+ years of experience in technical support, application support, or a customer-facing technical role.
 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
 * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose issues in SaaS applications.
 * Experience working with ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, Jira, ServiceNow) and monitoring tools.
 * Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical users.
 * Familiarity with financial crime prevention, fraud detection, compliance, or payments processing is highly desirable.
 * Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly in a customer-facing role.
 * Highly organized, able to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
 * Comfortable participating in international calls across multiple time zones.
 * German and English fluency
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Experience in AML, Fraud Prevention, or Compliance platforms
 * Familiarity with cloud-based platforms, APIs, and integrations
 * Previous experience in a SaaS, FinTech, or RegTech company

Über uns

Die ISEKI-Maschinen GmbH gehört deutschlandweit zu den führenden Anbietern von Kompakttraktoren, Mähern und Anbaugeräten für die professionelle Landschaftspflege und Bodenbearbeitung. Wir entwickeln und produzieren unser innovatives Maschinenprogramm für anspruchsvolle Kunden aus Industrie, Kommune und dem Garten- und Landschaftsbau an zwei modernen Fertigungsstandorten.

title: Data Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Das sind wir

Die SKOPOS GROUP kombiniert in ihren sechs spezialisierten Units die Expertise von 30 Jahren Marktforschungserfahrung mit innovativen Lösungen. Aktuell beschäftigen wir über 140 Mitarbeitende an den Standorten Hürth bei Köln, Aachen und München. Wir setzen auf individuelle Kundenlösungen, sind Marktforschende mit viel Herzblut und leben Teamwork in einer offenen, sympathischen Du-Kultur.

Die SKOPOS Group entwickelt derzeit mit „Agora“ eine zentrale Insights- und Datenplattform für die gesamte Unternehmensgruppe. Ziel der Plattform ist es, die heute fragmentierte Datenlandschaft der Marktforschung zu konsolidieren und eine gemeinsame technische Grundlage für Datenintegration, Analyse, Automatisierung und KI‑gestützte Anwendungen zu schaffen.

Im Projektgeschäft entstehen große Mengen wertvoller Daten – etwa aus Survey‑Plattformen wie Qualtrics oder Forsta, aus Projekt‑ und Studiensystemen sowie aus externen Datenquellen unserer Auftraggeber. Diese Daten liegen heute oft verteilt in unterschiedlichen Systemen und lassen sich nur mit hohem manuellem Aufwand zusammenführen und analysieren.

Mit „Agora“ entsteht daher eine cloudbasierte Daten‑ und Arbeitsplattform, die diese Daten automatisiert integriert und als Grundlage für neue Anwendungen nutzbar macht – von automatisierten Analysen und Reporting‑Lösungen bis hin zu KI‑basierten Insights‑Produkten.

Für den Aufbau dieser Plattform stellen wir derzeit ein neues Engineering‑Team zusammen. Hierzu suchen wir dich ab sofort in Vollzeit für unseren Standort in Aachen oder Hürth (mit der Möglichkeit zur hybriden Arbeit).

Das sind Deine Aufgaben


 * Entwicklung von Datenpipelines zur Integration verschiedener Datenquellen
 * Anbindung von Survey‑Plattformen und anderen Systemen über APIs
 * Transformation und Harmonisierung von Daten für Analysen
 * Aufbau automatisierter ETL/ELT‑Prozesse
 * Dokumentation und Wartung von Datenflüssen
 * Zusammenarbeit mit Data Platform und AI‑Teams
   
   

Besonderheiten der Stelle


 * Mitarbeit am Aufbau einer neuen Daten‑ und KI‑Plattform
 * Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum in Architektur und Technologieentscheidungen
 * Zusammenarbeit mit Data Science, Research und Consulting Teams
 * Möglichkeit, moderne Data‑ und AI‑Technologien praktisch einzusetzen
   
   

Das bringst Du mit


 * Studium Informatik, Data Engineering, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar
 * Kenntnisse in Python oder vergleichbaren Programmiersprachen
 * Gute SQL‑Kenntnisse
 * Erfahrung mit API‑Integration
 * Grundkenntnisse im Aufbau von Datenpipelines oder ETL‑Prozessen
 * Interesse an Datenplattformen und Analyseanwendungen
   
   

Warum wir?


 * Flexibilität. Hybrides Arbeiten mit Anteil Office/Mobile Office, flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell, Workation, Sabbaticals.
 * Innovative, dynamische Arbeitsatmosphäre. Freue Dich auf eine offene Du-Unternehmenskultur und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe, auch mit unseren Kunden.
 * Systematische Entwicklung und regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche.
 * Aktive Mitgestaltung. Kreative Lösungen und neue Wege sind willkommen.
 * Unbefristete Festanstellung.
 * Events: Teamausflüge, Firmenfeiern, Jubiläumsfahrten, Weihnachtsfeiern oder einfach mal so nach Feierabend.
 * GROUP Benefits. Zuschüsse zu Deutschlandticket, JobRad oder kostenfreier Parkplatz im Euronova Campus Hürth oder Aachen, Optimale ÖPNV-Anbindung, Büromassage und Fitness-Studio, Corporate Benefits, Getränke- und Müsliflat im Office, Beteiligung an der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Betriebsarzt und noch einiges mehr.
 * Nachhaltigkeit. Projekte zur Erreichung von Klimaneutralitätszielen, soziales Engagement, Unterstützung von NGOs.
   
   

Und jetzt?

Du findest dich in der Beschreibung wieder? Dann bewirb dich bei uns und überzeuge uns, warum gerade du perfekt zu uns passt. Bitte nenne uns dabei deinen nächstmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deine Gehaltsvorstellung. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Du willst noch mehr erfahren? Hier findest Du Insights zur SKOPOS GROUP..

Dein Kontakt

Oliver Kern (Geschäftsführer / SKOPOS CONNECT) & Yannick Thomsen (HR Generalist / SKOPOS GROUP), Telefon: 02233 – 9988990.

title: Data Scientist (Python & SQL) - Freelance AI Trainer
description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What This Opportunity Involves

While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:


 * Design original computational data science problems that simulate real-world analytical workflows across industries (telecom, finance, government, e-commerce, healthcare)
 * Create problems requiring Python programming to solve (using Pandas, Numpy, Scipy, Sklearn, Statsmodels, Matplotlib, Seaborn)
 * Ensure problems are computationally intensive and cannot be solved manually within reasonable timeframes (days/weeks)
 * Develop problems requiring non-trivial reasoning chains in data processing, statistical analysis, feature engineering, predictive modeling, and insight extraction
 * Create deterministic problems with reproducible answers: avoid stochastic elements or require fixed random seeds for exact reproducibility
 * Base problems on real business challenges: customer analytics, risk assessment, fraud detection, forecasting, optimization, and operational efficiency
 * Design end-to-end problems spanning the complete data science pipeline (data ingestion → cleaning → EDA → modeling → validation → deployment considerations)
 * Incorporate big data processing scenarios requiring scalable computational approaches
 * Verify solutions using Python with standard data science libraries and statistical methods
 * Document problem statements clearly with realistic business contexts and provide verified correct answers
   
   

What We Look For

This opportunity is a good fit for Data Science specialists with an experience in python open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:


 * 5+ years of hands-on data science experience with proven business impact
 * Portfolio of completed projects and publications showcasing real-world problem-solving
 * Expert Python programming for data science (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, statsmodels)
 * Expert statistical analysis and machine learning - deep understanding of algorithms, methods, and their practical applications
 * Expert with SQL and database operations for data manipulation and analysis
 * Experience with GenAI technologies (LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases)
 * Understanding of MLOps practices and model deployment workflows
 * Knowledge of modern frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain)
 * Strong written English (C1+)
   
   

How It Works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $58 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: System Engineer (English Speaking) (M/F/D)
description:
First insights

We’re looking for a System Engineer with experience in cloud migration, infrastructure, and hybrid

environments. You’ll lead the charge in planning and executing migrations, optimizing systems, and keeping

everything running smoothly across Azure and VMware.

If you thrive on technical deep dives, love tackling new challenges, and are always hungry to explore what’s

next in tech - we want to hear from you.

Location: Aveiro, Portugal

For this position, it is necessary to be available to come to the office at least 2x a week.

That’s What It’s About


 * Assess on-premises environments using Azure Migrate and develop tailored migration strategies (rehosting, re-platforming, refactoring).
 * Plan and execute migrations from on-premises infrastructure to cloud environments (Azure, VMware, hybrid).
 * Deploy and manage Azure networking components such as NSGs, Firewalls, and VNETs, maintaining security and performance standards.
 * Manage and troubleshoot Azure VMs, networks, and cloud infrastructure.
 * Use tools like Azure Migrate and VMware HCX to support seamless migrations.
 * Collaborate with internal IT teams to ensure minimal downtime and maximum performance.
 * Provide technical support and guidance to clients, ensuring cloud environments are secure, scalable, and efficient.
 * Monitor and troubleshoot cloud systems, implementing best practices for performance and reliability.
 * Stay up to date on Azure advancements, recommending process improvements, and leveraging new tools to enhance cloud migration efforts.
 * Maintain detailed system documentation and continuously improve infrastructure processes.
 * Bring strong technical, analytical, and supervisory skills with a collaborative mindset.
   
   

This is you

3+ years of experience in system engineering or IT infrastructure roles.


 * Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud migration strategies.
 * Strong knowledge of VMware, Hyper-V, Windows Server, Unix, Active Directory, Horizon/Citrix,
 * and networking.
 * Experience with Azure networking (VNets, NSGs, Application Gateways) and Azure Virtual Desktop.
 * Familiarity with cloud migration tools such as Azure Migrate or VMware HCX.
 * Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
 * Good team player with a proactive and positive mindset.
 * English fluency (German and/or Portuguese is a plus).
   
   

Nice to Have:


 * Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., AZ-104, AZ-305).
 * Experience with hybrid cloud environments.
 * Knowledge of scripting (PowerShell, Bash).
   
   

About Us

At MobiLab, we are committed to empowering our employees to bring their creative mindset into action, guiding our customers toward reaching their full data potential, and becoming Cloud-native organizations.

We are a diverse and dynamic team united by delivering engineering excellence. We are committed to inclusivity, where individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities, feel welcomed and valued. You will directly impact how future business works and contribute to industry-leading companies.

We are dedicated to growing our employees. Our company culture encourages knowledge sharing and learning with a dedicated MobiLab Career Development. Our headquarters, located in the heart of Cologne, offers a creative work environment. We provide a range of benefits, including a public transport ticket, access to industry conferences, a company pension scheme, and more.

If you’re passionate about Cloud Integration and striving for engineering perfection, we invite you to join our MobiLab Team. Let’s grow together!
